newsitem.title: USA: Wash Water continues restoration process.
newsitem.headline: Wash Water continues restoration process.

text.p: Washington Water Power Co said late on Friday that it would continue its work over the weekend to restore power to customers, mostly in the Spokane area, after rains and snow damaged transmission lines on Tuesday.

The company said its crew lost ground in Coeur d'Alene, where about 3,300 remained without service on Friday evening, because of additional snow and rain which increased the number of outages in northern Idaho. In addition to ongoing outages, three other distribution feeders were out of service on Friday, the company said.
The company said that it had completed much of the work on the 47 Spokane-area distribution feeders that were out of service following Tuesday's storm.
It said that work on restoring service on the "lateral" lines that come off the main distribution feeders and extend into individual neighborhoods would also be carried out over the weekend.
In some instances, the lines will need to be reconstructed, the company said.
